title: Shall We Dance (bc30)
synopsis: Suo Masayuki's global breakout hit made Koji Yakusho a household name, sweeping numerous accolades. Revealing a gentler side to its star, this delightful classic follows a bored salaryman who takes up ballroom dancing on a whim, escaping his ennui alongside eccentric classmates. Yakusho's adorably awkward performance epitomised a generation of silent men who could all use a little dancing in their lives. As the opening film of bc, it surpassed HK$2 million at the box office during an exclusive run, establishing a house record that has stood ever since.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 杉山邁入男人四十，事業家庭皆穩定，買了房子的他令人稱羨，壓力卻只有自己知。某日下班乘電車經過舞蹈教室，被舞蹈老師憑窗眺望的倩影深深吸引。他瞞住妻兒去學社交舞，本來只抱着非份之想，不料越跳越投入，枯燥的生活從此泛起漣漪。周防正行這部作品創下 13 座日本電影學院獎的空前大滿貫，亦是役所廣司演藝生涯的重大突破︰接演時，他被質疑欠缺票房號召力；電影上映後，他躍升為日本最炙手可熱的男星，橫掃多個男主角獎。本片是 bc 開幕電影，獨家上映突破 200 萬票房， 紀錄至 今還未被打破。

cast: Koji Yakusho, Tamiyo Kusakari, Naoto Takenaka, Akira Emoto
